title: A standing pick leaves the Pick stands section only on the owner's answer or a reversal
why: Owner 11:15 CST Nov 13: "where are all the overridable pick stuff that triage used to provide me in the artifact". Cause (triage read of the page, 11:20 CST): 39 stood picks closed with no owner answer. 25 closed in the retrospective's Nov 12 audit (12:57 to 13:19 CST), including 6 it found sound, which should have kept standing. No new stood pick reached the page from 12:34 CST Nov 12 to 10:56 CST Nov 13, because #2870 (step pick-reaches-page) never landed. The section showed 2 picks.
source: owner 11:15 CST Nov 13, relayed by the coordinator 11:16 CST
note: The export check (export_page.py checks) flags an item with stands true, status closed, no answers/<id> and no lastAnswer whose reply does not start "Reversed" or "Withdrawn". Red case: the 6 sound picks closed at 13:19 CST Nov 12. Restored 11:20 CST Nov 13: 5 reopened (565, 566, 572, 583, 584; 578 left closed, as 699 b superseded it), and triage's two 11:15 CST picks added as 706 and 707. Express (ruling drain-first-hold part 4: it tracks owner work). Pairs with step pick-reaches-page.
